description: Hey everyone! We are Cosmicode, a crew of enthusiastic first-year CSE engineering students diving into our first hackathon adventure. We blend fresh logic with creative UI thinking, focusing on web development, interactive design, and building immersive space apps We are looking for passionate teammates who bring skills in coding, UI/UX design, data storytelling, or creative problem-solving If you love space tech, clean code, and building cool things under pressure, let's team up and launch this
